meta.title: Twenty Eleven Showcase Slider — Live Preview
meta.description: Sticky featured posts auto-rotate on the Twenty Eleven Showcase template.

steps.data:
<?php
/**
 * Seeds the Playground preview with sticky featured posts and a
 * page that uses the Twenty Eleven Showcase template.
 *
 * Runs once on the next admin request, then deletes itself.
 */
add_action( 'admin_init', function () {
	if ( get_option( 'twenty_eleven_showcase_slider_seeded' ) ) {
		return;
	}

	require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/file.php';
	require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/media.php';
	require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/image.php';

	update_option( 'permalink_structure', '/%postname%/' );

	$titles = array(
		'The Quiet Mountains',
		'A City After Rain',
		'Morning at the Harbor',
		'Across the Open Plains',
		'Light Through the Trees',
	);

	$sticky = array();

	foreach ( $titles as $i => $title ) {
		$post_id = wp_insert_post( array(
			'post_title'   => $title,
			'post_content' => 'A featured story to demonstrate the Twenty Eleven Showcase Slider carousel.',
			'post_status'  => 'publish',
			'post_type'    => 'post',
		) );

		$image_url     = 'https://picsum.photos/seed/showcase' . ( $i + 1 ) . '/1000/288';
		$attachment_id = media_sideload_image( $image_url, $post_id, $title, 'id' );
		if ( ! is_wp_error( $attachment_id ) ) {
			set_post_thumbnail( $post_id, $attachment_id );
		}

		$sticky[] = $post_id;
	}

	update_option( 'sticky_posts', $sticky );

	$page_id = wp_insert_post( array(
		'post_title'   => 'Showcase',
		'post_content' => '',
		'post_status'  => 'publish',
		'post_type'    => 'page',
		'meta_input'   => array( '_wp_page_template' => 'showcase.php' ),
	) );

	update_option( 'show_on_front', 'page' );
	update_option( 'page_on_front', $page_id );

	flush_rewrite_rules();
	update_option( 'twenty_eleven_showcase_slider_seeded', 1 );

	@unlink( __FILE__ );
} );
